notes.title: Two new achievements! (And some new art too)
notes.content:
Hey Everyone, 

Excited to announce that two new achievements are now live! 

   [*] Charged Hit: Trigger this by landing a fully charged attack against Medusa. 

   [*] Beat Arcade Mode in a Minute or Less!: Exactly what it sounds like. If your existing best time is a minute or less, simply beat Arcade Mode (with any time) to trigger this achievement. 

And say goodbye to Perseus's sashaying South-facing run animation! I've replaced it with more of a black ops / commando shuffle instead. Let me know what you think--C&C appreciated! 

Thanks as always for your interest and support. Keep the feedback coming! 

- Dan from New Hell

notes.title: Controller and Controls release update
notes.content:
Hi all,

Pushed a fix that should resolve the "Perseus running in place" issue and improve gamepad support.

When using a 360 type controller, make sure to set the D-pad to the d-pad controls on the input launch, and the joystick to the joystick spots. New Hell officially recommends using the d-pad. If you have a different controller and can't get the d-pad to set on the d-pad inputs, map each button (up, down, left, right) to the corresponding button slot for each direction.

Please add us as a friend on steam or reach out via newhellstudios@gmail.com if you have any issues, we are happy to help!

~Drew from New Hell
